description: This file defines an interface named CalendarSyncConfigInterface for managing calendar synchronization configurations in SuiteCRM. It specifies method signatures for retrieving and setting various configuration parameters related to calendar sync operations, such as concurrency, time windows, conflict resolution, deletion permissions, and hooks.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns an array of all configuration keys.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns an array of all configuration values.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets configuration values; takes an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: getMaxAccountsPerSync
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of calendar accounts processed per sync.

methods.name: getMaxOperationsPerAccount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of meeting operations per account per sync.

methods.name: getSyncWindowPastDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days into the past to be synchronized.

methods.name: getSyncWindowFutureDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days into the future to be synchronized.

methods.name: getConflictResolution
methods.description: Returns the conflict resolution strategy identifier.

methods.name: allowInternalEventDeletion
methods.description: Indicates if internal event deletion is allowed.

methods.name: allowExternalEventDeletion
methods.description: Indicates if external event deletion is allowed.

methods.name: enableCalendarSyncLogicHooks
methods.description: Indicates if calendar sync logic hooks should be executed.

methods.name: getExternalCalendarName
methods.description: Returns the external calendar name used in sync operations.

methods.name: getLastManualRunTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last manual sync run, or null if never run.

methods.name: setLastManualRunTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last manual sync run.
